# Mazariegos Painting & Roofing

Mazariegos Painting & Roofing is a trusted, family-run home improvement contractor based in Stamford, CT, led by Milton and his skilled team. The business is known for delivering high-quality craftsmanship across roofing, painting, gutters, and chimney work — consistently praised for being professional, timely, thorough, and reasonably priced. Customers highlight their transparency (providing photo updates during projects), attention to detail, and ability to diagnose and solve problems efficiently. With a strong reputation built on glowing local reviews, the brand exudes reliability, integrity, and hands-on expertise.

# Expert Roofing, Painting, Gutters & Chimney Services in Stamford, CT


From complete roof replacements to meticulous exterior painting and gutter installations, Mazariegos Painting & Roofing delivers dependable workmanship, practical recommendations, and transparent communication — backed by a legacy of local trust and glowing reviews.







Roofing



Painting



Gutters



Chimney
















01

## Expert Roofing Replacement & Repair


From weather-worn shingles to complete roof replacements, our team delivers durable, watertight results that protect your home for decades. We use premium materials and proven installation techniques to ensure every layer—from underlayment to ridge cap—is flawless.


- Comprehensive inspections identify hidden leaks, rot, and structural weaknesses before they become costly emergencies.

- Full tear-off and replacement with architectural shingles, metal roofing, or flat-roof systems tailored to New England weather.

- Photo updates throughout the project so you see exactly what's happening above your head.




We commonly solve: persistent ceiling stains, missing shingles, ice dam damage, and poor attic ventilation causing premature roof failure.











02

## Interior & Exterior House Painting


Our painting process goes far beyond a simple coat of color. We prioritize meticulous surface preparation—power washing, scraping, sanding, caulking, and priming—so the finish is smooth, even, and built to withstand sun, rain, and seasonal shifts.


- Thorough prep work eliminates peeling paint at the source, not just covering it up temporarily.

- Premium paints and stains applied with brush, roller, and spray techniques for consistent coverage on siding, trim, and doors.

- Clean, contained job sites with daily cleanup so your family's routine stays uninterrupted.




We commonly solve: blistering and peeling exterior paint, faded siding, moisture intrusion behind failing caulk, and dated interior color schemes.











03

## Gutter Installation & Guard Systems


Properly sized and pitched gutters are your home's first defense against foundation damage, basement flooding, and landscape erosion. We install seamless aluminum gutters and effective guard systems that keep water flowing and debris out.


- Seamless gutter runs custom-fabricated on-site for a perfect fit with no leaky joints.

- Gutter guards installed to prevent clogs from leaves and pine needles, reducing ladder trips.

- Downspout extensions and drainage solutions that direct water safely away from your foundation.




We commonly solve: overflowing gutters, sagging sections pulling away from fascia, basement water intrusion, and ice buildup in winter.











04

## Chimney Flashing & Leak Prevention


Chimney leaks are among the most deceptive home issues—water travels far from the entry point before showing stains. We specialize in copper and aluminum flashing, cricket installation, and crown repair to stop leaks at the source.


- Old flashing removed and replaced with step, counter, and apron flashing for a watertight seal.

- Cricket (saddle) installation behind wide chimneys to divert water and prevent debris buildup.

- Chimney crown repair and waterproofing to protect masonry from freeze-thaw cycles.




We commonly solve: water stains around the fireplace, musty attic odors near the chimney chase, deteriorated mortar crowns, and rusted flashing.





















## How We Handle Every Project, From First Assessment to Finished Result


Our process is built on transparency, punctuality, and documenting progress every step of the way. As a trusted roof replacement contractor and exterior home specialist, we never overlook hidden causes — we diagnose, explain, and solve problems efficiently so you know exactly what to expect.





01


### Inspect & Diagnose


Every project begins with a thorough on-site evaluation. We don't just look at the surface — we inspect for underlying issues, hidden water damage, and structural weaknesses. For chimney repairs, for instance, we trace leaks to their actual source before recommending a fix. This diagnostic-first approach ensures our chimney repair cost estimates are accurate and complete, with no surprise expenses later.





02


### Clear Recommendation


We present a straightforward, detailed scope of work with transparent pricing. Whether it's a full roof replacement or gutter installation contractors sizing the right system, you'll receive a clear plan with material options, timeline, and honest advice. We believe an informed homeowner makes the best decisions — we answer every question patiently and never push unnecessary upgrades.





03


### Complete Work With Photo Updates


Our team arrives on time, works clean, and keeps you in the loop. Throughout the project, we provide regular photo updates so you can see progress — new flashing installed, rotten wood replaced, fresh coats of exterior house painting going up — even if you can't be on site. This commitment to transparency is something our customers consistently highlight in their reviews.





04


### Final Cleanup & Walkthrough


We treat your home with respect from start to finish. After the work is complete, we do a meticulous cleanup — magnetic sweeping for nails, washing down surfaces, and removing all debris. Then we walk the property with you to review every detail and ensure the finished product meets our high standards and your complete satisfaction.








Our experience has taught us that small, overlooked details — a tiny flashing gap, a hairline crack in a chimney crown, a poorly pitched gutter — can lead to big problems. We actively look for those hidden causes so your investment is protected for the long haul.

# Trusted Local Team,Family-Run Values


Mazariegos Painting & Roofing is built on the belief that every home deserves meticulous care and honest craftsmanship. Led by Milton and his skilled crew, we treat every roof, wall, and gutter as if it were our own.









## Reputation Built on Results


From complete roof replacement contractor services to precise chimney repair and exterior house painting, our reputation is our foundation. Homeowners across Stamford and Fairfield County rely on us because we deliver consistent, high-quality results at fair, transparent prices. Every project is a chance to prove why we're the area's most recommended home improvement contractor.





## Hands-On Work Ethic


We're not just a business — we're a team that shows up on time, works clean, and doesn't leave until the job is done right. Whether it's gutter installation contractors tackling a complex drainage system or a full exterior refresh, our crew brings years of hands-on expertise and genuine care to every detail. We understand that quality workmanship is what turns first-time clients into lifelong customers.





## Communication You Can Count On


We believe transparency builds trust. That's why we provide regular photo updates throughout your project, clearly explain every step of the process, and always answer your questions directly. No surprises, no hidden fees — just honest communication and craftsmanship you can see. When you work with Mazariegos, you're never left wondering about the status of your home.









Milton and the team — Stamford's trusted home improvement crew

## Common Homeowner Questions


Straightforward answers about how we work, so you know exactly what to expect from start to finish.











### What types of work do you handle?


We specialize in roofing, exterior and interior painting, seamless gutter installation, chimney repairs, and gutter guard systems. If it protects or beautifies your home's exterior, we likely do it.










### Do you provide free estimates?


Yes. We offer transparent, no-obligation estimates for every project. You'll get a clear breakdown of the scope and cost before any work begins, with no hidden fees.










### What do "photo updates" mean during a project?


We send you real-time photos as the job progresses — from the initial inspection to the final walk-through. You'll see exactly what's happening on your home, even if you're not there.










### Is cleanup included after the work is done?


Absolutely. We treat your home like our own. Our team performs a thorough cleanup at the end of each day and a final sweep before we leave, so you won't find nails, debris, or paint chips behind.










### How quickly can you start after the estimate?


We pride ourselves on being responsive. Depending on the season and project size, we can often begin within a week or two. We'll give you a firm start date during the estimate process so there are no surprises.










### Can you diagnose existing problems with my roof or chimney?


Yes. Milton and the team are known for being knowledgeable and thorough. We inspect, identify the root cause — whether it's a hidden leak, flashing failure, or structural issue — and explain the fix in plain language before we proceed.

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/4/2026



Mazariegos Painting & Roofing ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: Mazariegos Painting & Roofing

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]

- Address: [business_address]



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 4, 2026



Mazariegos Painting & Roofing is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: Mazariegos Painting & Roofing

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
